calibration_sources: SGLang RadixAttention / vLLM Offline Batch Prefix-Tree Sorting & Length-Aware Binning Architecture
Ray Data LLM / SkyPilot Spot Instance Micro-Shard Checkpointing & Graceful SIGTERM Drain
OpenAI / Anthropic 50%-Off Batch API Economics vs Dedicated Spot GPU Offline Throughput Roofline

workload_baseline.prompt_structure: 120 templates × (3,500 shared prefix + 500 unique input + 400 output tokens)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive FIFO Dumping into Online Serving Queue (Random Template Order + Mixed Short/Long Lengths)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 原始 FIFO 乱序硬塞在线队列 (随机模板到达冲垮缓存 + 长短句混批显存空洞)
tiers.mechanism: Processes 10M batch requests in random arrival order on on-demand instances; 120 templates thrash HBM KV cache

tiers.name: Tier 2: Unsorted Spot Instance Pool without Checkpointing (Cheap GPU-hr but 28.5% Re-Run Waste & Thrashing)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 粗放 Spot 竞价实例乱序跑批 (无前缀分桶 + 被回收时整批重跑丢失 28.5% 算力)
tiers.mechanism: Runs unsorted large batches on Spot GPUs ($0.85/hr) without sub-batch checkpointing; SIGTERM loses 30-min in-flight batches

tiers.name: Tier 3: Global Radix Prefix-Tree Sorting + Length-Homogeneous Micro-Batch Binning (On-Demand Pool)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 全局 Radix 共享前缀分桶排序 + 长度同质微批打包 (按需实例池)
tiers.mechanism: Pre-sorts 10M prompts by prefix hash tree then by output/input length budget; 100% of same-template prompts run back-to-back

tiers.name: Tier 4: Spot Pool + Radix Prefix/Length Bucketing + 30s Micro-Shard Checkpointing + Host DRAM Paged KV
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: Spot 竞价池 + Radix 前缀/长度双维分桶 + 30秒微片落盘续跑 + 主机内存 KV 零重算
tiers.mechanism: Combines global prefix/length sorting with Spot instances, 512-prompt atomic Parquet micro-commits, and SIGTERM 30s graceful drain

prefix_ratio_perturbation.scenario: Low Prefix Sharing (25% Shared System Prompt, 1,000 / 4,000 tok)
prefix_ratio_perturbation.driver: Length-sorted homogeneous binning eliminates short/long padding & decode stragglers

prefix_ratio_perturbation.scenario: Medium Prefix Sharing (50% Shared Few-Shot Prompt, 2,000 / 4,000 tok)
prefix_ratio_perturbation.driver: Radix prefix sorting eliminates 50% of redundant prefill compute + length binning

prefix_ratio_perturbation.scenario: High Prefix Sharing (80% Shared Schema/Catalog Prompt, 3,500 / 4,400 tok)
prefix_ratio_perturbation.driver: 95.8% prefix cache hit turns compute-bound prefill into instant HBM pointer reuse

prefix_ratio_perturbation.scenario: Document Multi-Question Extraction (90% Shared 16K Document, 20 Questions/Doc)
prefix_ratio_perturbation.driver: Grouping all 20 questions per 16K doc into one micro-batch reads 16K KV only once
